description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer extended-attribute checkpoint: safe Rust owns SGR rendition reset semantics and color persistence through cell writes for microsoft/terminal#2554.

entries.notes: Safe Rust enumerates every extended-rendition combination, persists the active TextAttribute into a written cell, applies the Microsoft shared and individual SGR resets, and returns to default rendition.

Safe Rust composes all extended-rendition combinations with default, 16-color, 256-color and RGB foreground/background encodings; rendition resets preserve colors and 39/49 independently restore default colors.
